title_en: In the Courtroom (16/20): A Handshake After Mediation
note_en: 达成 means "to reach" an outcome and almost always takes an abstract object such as 一致 or 协议: 双方终于达成了一致 "the two sides finally reached an agreement." English can "reach" a place or an agreement, but 达成 only works with results, so you can't use it for arriving somewhere; for that, Chinese uses 到达.
